questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if '+' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

35 - 28 ÷ 7 + 322 × 23 = ?
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/784b90b54b9f26832ca7194db9e5f493ad1ce0f1e8af95a0c85fff0f49af3e51.png] 

Given:

⇒ 35 - 28 ÷ 7 + 322 × 23

After interchanging '+' and '-' & '×' and '÷' →

⇒ 35 + 28 × 7 - 322 ÷ 23

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 35 + 28 × 7 - __**322 ÷ 23**__

⇒ 35 + __**28 × 7**__ - 14

⇒ 35 + 196 - 14

⇒ 231 - 14 = **217**

**⇒ '35 + 28 × 7 - 322 ÷ 23 = 217'**

Here, the value of the equation is '217'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".

questions.question: In an examination, a student loses 1 mark for every wrong answer and gets 3 marks for every correct answer. If he answers all the 100 questions and scores 88 marks, how many questions did he answer correctly?
questions.solution:
Let the number of correct answers be x

Number of incorrect answers = (100 – x)

According to question;

3x – (100 – x) = 88

⇒ 3x - 100 + x = 88

⇒ 4x = 88 + 100

⇒ 4x = 188

⇒ x = 47

So, the number of questions are correct = 47

Hence, **"47"** is the correct answer.

• Focus on intensive education and awareness campaigns to ensure that people understand the need for safe sanitation.
 
• Take the scheme beyond rural **households** to** rural schools** and **nursery schools.** Here again, the emphasis was placed on promoting good hygiene practices.

questions.question: A circular road runs around a circular ground. If the radius of the ground is 7 m and the difference between the circumferences of the outer circle and the inner circle is 44 m then the area of the road is:
questions.solution:
**Formula Used:**

Area of Circle = π × r²

Circumference of Circle = 2π × r

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4079bc4fe75ff30abf12e799ab28fc3338350b1f3b43a976738ddd25f709ec1.png] 

Let radius of ground be r & radius of road be R

Difference between circumference = 44m

Using above formula -

⇒ 2π (R - r) = 44

⇒ 2π (R - 7)= 44

⇒ (44)/(7)(R - 7) = 44

⇒ R - 7 = 7

⇒ R = 14 m

⇒ Area of road = π (R² - r²) = π (142 - 72) 

⇒ Area of road = (22/7)× 147 = 462 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 462 m²**

questions.question: Anju and Manju can together complete a piece of work in 30 days. After 18 days Anju left and it took Manju another 20 days to finish the work. How long will it take for Manju to finish the whole work all alone?

**Concept Used:**

If a person do a work in x days, their one day work is 1/x part of the total work.

**Calculation:**

Let's assume that Anju's can complete work in x days and Manju can complete work in y days.

One day work of Anju is 1/x part and one day work of Manju is 1/y part of the work.

Together they can complete work in 30 days,

So together they can work in one day is 1/30 part

1/x + 1/y = 1/30 ----(1)

Also, we know that in the first 18 days, Anju and Manju worked together,

So 18 days work of both is 18 × 1/30 = 18/30 = 3/5

Remaining work = 1 - 3/5 = 2/5

As Manju need 20 more days to complete work, 

So, 20 days of Manju's work should equal to 2/5 part of the work

20 × 1/y = 2/5

⇒ 20 × 5 = 2y

⇒ y = 50

**Therefore, Manju will take 50 days to complete the whole work all alone.**
